title: Question Answering for Children: Sentence Similarity and a Fine-Tuned DistilBERT
caption: The DistilBERT fine-tuning loop from the project, as it appears in the report.
description: My part of a 2021 final year group project: find the sentence that answers a question with InferSent features and a random forest (67.6%), then extract the exact answer with DistilBERT (62.5% exact match).
